text.Mevduattan fonlara yatırım araçlarını ri: Get to know investment instruments, from deposits to funds, by risk level, and calculate how your regular savings can grow over time.
text.Hedeflerine ve risk tercihine uygun yatı: Get to know investment instruments that suit your goals and risk preference, and calculate how your regular savings can grow over time.
text.Mevduattan fonlara yatırım araçları: Investment instruments from deposits to funds
text.Düzenli birikimin ne kadar büyür?: How much will your regular savings grow?
text.Hesaplama, girdiğin sabit yıllık getiriy: The calculation is an estimate based on the fixed annual return you enter, compounded monthly. Actual returns vary depending on market conditions and the instrument you choose.
text.Riskine uygun aracı seç: Choose the instrument that matches your risk
text.Her yatırım aracının getiri potansiyeli: Each investment instrument has a different return potential and risk. Spreading your savings across different instruments reduces your risk.
text.Sabit faizle öngörülebilir getiri. Kısa: Predictable returns at a fixed interest rate. Suitable for short-term savings and an emergency fund.
text.Devletin borçlanma araçları. Vadesine ka: Government debt instruments. When held to maturity, the return is known from the outset.
text.Uzman yönetimiyle farklı varlıklara dağı: A basket diversified across different assets under professional management. Risk levels range from money market funds to equity funds.
text.Enflasyona ve kur dalgalanmalarına karşı: A traditional hedge against inflation and currency fluctuations. You can accumulate it gram by gram with a bank gold account.
text.Şirketlere ortak olarak uzun vadede yüks: High long-term return potential by becoming a shareholder in companies. Short-term price volatility is high.
text.Devlet katkısıyla desteklenen uzun vadel: Long-term retirement savings supported by a government contribution. Your contributions are invested in the funds you choose.
text.Bilinçli yatırımın dört temeli: The four foundations of informed investing
text.Ev, araç, eğitim ya da emeklilik: biriki: A home, a car, education or retirement: be clear about what you're saving for.
text.Paranın değer kaybına ne kadar katlanabi: Know how much loss in value you can tolerate, and choose your instruments accordingly.
text.Birikimini farklı araçlara dağıtarak tek: Spread your savings across different instruments so you don't depend on a single risk.
text.Uzun vadeli ve düzenli birikim, kısa vad: Long-term, regular saving reduces the impact of short-term fluctuations.
text.Birikimini doğru araçlarla büyüt: Grow your savings with the right instruments
text.Yatırım, birikimini değerlendirerek uzun: Investing is one of the most effective ways to put your savings to work and reach your financial goals over the long term. Choosing the right instruments helps you both increase your income and protect your savings against inflation. Deposits, bonds, gold, investment funds and stocks can be combined according to your risk preference and goals.
text.Yatırım yapmadan önce risk toleransını v: Before investing, you should determine your risk tolerance and goals. Instruments with high return potential generally carry higher risk. By spreading your savings in a balanced way, you can both reduce your risk and increase your returns.
text.Uzun vadenin gücü: The power of the long term
text.Düzenli ve uzun vadeli birikim, getirini: Regular, long-term saving accelerates over time thanks to the compounding effect, where your returns earn returns too. You can see this effect for yourself by extending the duration in the calculator above.
text.Bu sayfadaki bilgiler genel bilgilendirm: The information on this page is for general informational purposes only and does not constitute investment advice. Investment advisory services are provided within the framework of an investment advisory agreement to be signed between the client and brokerage firms, portfolio management companies or non-deposit-taking banks.
text.Yatırıma ne kadarla başlayabilirim?: How much do I need to start investing?
text.Vadeli mevduat, yatırım fonları ve altın: You can start with small amounts using instruments such as time deposits, investment funds and gold accounts. Saving regularly matters more than the amount.
text.Risk seviyemi nasıl belirlerim?: How do I determine my risk level?
text.Birikimine ne zaman ihtiyaç duyacağını v: Consider when you'll need your savings and how much loss in value you can tolerate. Deposits stand out for short-term, safe savings, while instruments such as funds and stocks stand out for long-term, growth-oriented savings.
text.Mevduat sabit ve öngörülebilir bir getir: Deposits offer a fixed and predictable return. Investment funds, depending on their composition, carry higher return potential, but their value can fluctuate. Many investors use both together to spread their risk.
text.Talebin bize ulaştıktan sonra seninle il: Once we receive your request, we'll get in touch with you and share the bank options where you can open an investment account, along with the application steps.
text.Birikimine yön vermeye hazır mısın?: Ready to give direction to your savings?
text.Yatırım hesabı başvurunu bırak, hesabını: Submit your investment account application, and we'll get back to you with the bank options where you can open your account.
